## BlockSignal portfolio monitor
Import, review the real HPD IDs, test the request, then publish to enable the schedule. Static baseline data persists only on successful published executions; manual tests do not persist it. First run establishes a baseline. No notification credentials or recipients are configured. Attach your own notification node after Changes only. Maximum 25 buildings / 1,000 open records: overflow fails instead of reporting false removals. For production teams, replace experimental workflow static data with a durable database and concurrency control.
